pages.method: GitHub Pages branch build: push/merge to main at / triggers built-in pages-build-deployment

expectedPostMergeWorkflows.triggerBlock:
workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      site_ids:
        description: "커밋할 탐조지 ID (공백으로 구분). 비우면 바뀐 파일을 모두 커밋한다."
        required: false
        default: "15 16 194"

schedule:
    # GitHub Actions cron uses UTC. 18:15 UTC is 03:15 KST the following day.
    - cron: "15 18 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      days:
        description: Number of days to generate
        required: true
        default: "31"
        type: string

push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - ".github/scripts/update_tide.py"
      - ".github/scripts/audit_tide_health.py"
      - ".github/scripts/build_tide_station_mapping.py"
      - ".github/scripts/tide_official_stations.json"
      - ".github/scripts/test_tide.py"
      - ".github/scripts/test_tide_fallback.mjs"
      - "tide_station_mapping.json"
      - ".github/workflows/update-tide.yml"
      - "data/birdmap_latest_v24_MasterDB_조석연동_업데이트용.xlsx"
  schedule:
    # GitHub Actions cron uses UTC. 15:05 UTC is 00:05 KST the following day.
    - cron: "5 15 * * *"
    # Backup refresh: 21:05 UTC is 06:05 KST, preventing stale daily tide data if the midnight run is missed or conflicts.
    - cron: "5 21 * * *"
    # Recovery refreshes: 23:35/01:35 UTC are 08:35/10:35 KST; complete data makes them no-ops.
    - cron: "35 23 * * *"
    - cron: "35 1 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - ".github/scripts/update_weather.py"
      - ".github/scripts/site_data.py"
      - ".github/scripts/test_weather.py"
      - ".github/scripts/validate_weather.py"
      - ".github/scripts/validate_weather_week.py"
      - "weather_rules.json"
      - "weather-proxy/src/sites.js"
      - "weather-proxy/test/**"
      - "index.html"
      - ".github/workflows/update-weather.yml"
  schedule:
    # GitHub Actions cron uses UTC. 15:20 UTC is 00:20 KST: it refills the daily
    # file right after midnight, when the saved date has just gone stale. The
    # 00:05 KST tide run shares birdmap-data-refresh, so it finishes first.
    - cron: "20 15 * * *"
    # 05:35 KST, before the 06:05 KST tide refresh in the same group.
    - cron: "35 20 * * *"
    - cron: "17 1 * * *"
    - cron: "17 5 * * *"
    - cron: "17 9 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

interpretation: Pages branch mode can publish automatically upon main merge; merging and frontend publishing are coupled operational actions.
Publication security CI only follows its recorded trigger block; main push is not assumed to rerun it.
Scheduled/path-triggered data workflows can create later automatic JSON commits and further Pages builds.
Recheck current main/head and required checks immediately before actual merge.
